description: Schedule (or send immediately) an existing draft campaign to an audience/segment/topic. Before calling, confirm with the user: show them the recipients (or the recipient count), the sender and the subject, and wait for a clear yes. Send16 can refuse a send. 429 SEND_RAMP_LIMIT: new and free workspaces have hourly and daily sending limits while they build reputation; the error details give the window, the limit and how many remain. Tell the user how many can go now and that the rest can go once the window resets (or after upgrading), and do not split the send or retry in a loop to get around it. 403 SENDING_PAUSED: sending from the workspace is paused while the Send16 team reviews it. Nothing was sent. Tell the user to check the workspace owner's email or contact support, and do not retry. 422 MESSAGE_NEEDS_REVIEW: the content looked like it might be impersonating a government agency, bank, toll operator or delivery company, so it was held and not sent. Tell the user it is held for review and they can contact support if it is legitimate. Do not reword it and try again; repeated flags pause the workspace.

apiKey.description: Send16 API key (overrides SEND16_API_KEY env var)

scheduleAt.description: ISO-8601 future datetime; omit to send immediately

name: schedule_campaign
title: Schedule or send campaign
